acceptance: A guard fails when a test in the package ends with runner.DefaultRouter different from its start value, or the variable no longer exists.
The whole cmd/evolve package passes in a shuffled order.
fix: Find each test that leaves the variable set and restore it, or pass the router through the wiring so that no process-wide variable exists.
summary: runner.DefaultRouter is a process-wide variable. A test that reaches cmd_cycle.go:498 or cli_routing_root.go:156 without a cleanup leaves it set, so a later test routes on the wrong table. The login journey test failed only in the whole package run for this reason.
title: A test in cmd/evolve leaves runner.DefaultRouter set for later tests
